note: Voyager project page: automatic curriculum as 'an in-context form of novelty search', state-grounded task proposals, self-verification critic, 3.3x unique items and up to 15.3x tech-tree results.
Go-Explore (Ecoffet et al.): remember previously visited states, first return to a promising state then explore from it; Montezuma's Revenge mean over 43,000 (~4x prior SOTA).

Curiosity-driven exploration by self-supervised prediction (Pathak et al., ICML 2017): prediction-error intrinsic reward; no-reward exploration learns navigation/combat; sparse-reward runs reach goals with far fewer interactions.
Open-Ended Learning Leads to Generally Capable Agents (DeepMind XLand): dynamically generated task distributions so the agent never stops learning; zero-shot generalization to held-out games.
Pangu-Agent (Christianos et al.): fine-tunable generalist agent; agents 'perform and adapt far better when organised reasoning and prior knowledge are embedded'.
